comment: The section defines a regional strategic governance body but does not address whether a regional operational governance function exists or is expected for shared components (e.g. who performs release management or service-level monitoring for infrastructure shared across countries). This mirrors the operational/strategic split established in 3.4.3–3.4.4 for the national level but leaves the regional level only half-specified.

public.text: The section defines a regional strategic governance body but does not address whether a regional operational governance function exists or is expected for shared components (e.g. who performs release management or service-level monitoring for infrastructure shared across countries). This mirrors the operational/strategic split established in 3.4.3–3.4.4 for the national level but leaves the regional level only half-specified.
public.suggestedRevision: Either state explicitly that regional operational governance is out of scope and remains nationally delegated per component, or add a short subsection defining a regional operational governance function analogous to 3.4.4.
